about: Events marked on the steps of the story 'Money in, money out' (src/app/stories/money-in-money-out): the official record of what changed around each series. Each is from a Reserve Bank of India or Government of India document, read on 13-10-2026; 'quote' is copied from it, and 'note' says only what the source says. 'slide' names the step it is shown on; 'day' is the date the source gives. An event with no 'url' is held back: the story shows only what it can link. data/processors/story-money-in-money-out.mjs checks each date and each link.

events.label: Evacuation from Kuwait
events.note: Indians in Kuwait were flown home between 13 August and 20 October 1990, after Iraq's invasion of Kuwait on 2 August 1990.

events.label: The national lockdown
events.note: The Prime Minister announced a lockdown of the whole country for 21 days from midnight on 24 March 2020.
events.source_title: Press Information Bureau (PIB), Prime Minister's Office, 24-03-2020
events.quote: a complete lockdown of the entire nation for the next 21 days

events.label: “Highest ever”
events.note: The Ministry of Finance told the Rajya Sabha that the $89,127 million received in 2021-22 was the highest in a single year.
events.quote: the highest ever inward remittances received in a single year

events.label: The 2013 deposit window
events.note: The RBI offered banks a swap for fresh FCNR(B) dollar deposits of three years or more at a fixed 3.5% a year, open until 30 November 2013.
events.quote: a window to the banks to swap fresh FCNR(B) dollar funds, mobilised for a minimum tenor of three years and over at a fixed rate of 3.5 per cent per annum

events.label: The 2013 swaps unwind
events.note: An RBI Bulletin article records the unwinding of the special FCNR(B) swaps with the Reserve Bank in September to November 2016.
events.quote: unwinding of special FCNR(B) swaps with the Reserve Bank during September-November 2016

events.label: The 2026 deposit window
events.note: The RBI opened a swap facility for FCNR(B) deposits of three to five years, for deposits taken until 30 September 2026.

events.label: $65.40 bn in FCNR(B)
events.note: The Ministry of Finance reported $73 billion raised under the facility by 21 August 2026, $65.40 billion of it in FCNR(B) deposits; the FCNR(B) window was closed early, on 31 August 2026. It put the 2013 scheme at about $26 billion.
events.quote: FCNR(B) deposits alone accounted for US $65.40 billion

events.label: LRS begins
events.note: The Liberalised Remittance Scheme began with a limit of $25,000.
events.source_title: RBI FAQ, Liberalised Remittance Scheme limit
events.quote: The Scheme was introduced on February 4, 2004, with a limit of USD 25,000.

events.label: Cut to $75,000
events.note: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 24 reduced the limit from $200,000 to $75,000.
events.source_title: RBI Master Direction on the LRS, list of circulars
events.quote: Reduction of limit from USD 200,000 to USD 75,000

events.label: Raised to $125,000
events.note: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 138 raised the limit from $75,000 to $125,000.
events.source_title: RBI Master Direction on the LRS, list of circulars
events.quote: Increase in the limit from USD 75,000 to USD 125,000

events.label: Raised to $250,000
events.note: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 106 raised the limit from $125,000 to $250,000 a financial year; separate limits for travel, gifts and other purposes had been folded into the LRS from 26 May 2015.
events.source_title: RBI Master Direction on the LRS, list of circulars
events.quote: increase in the limit from USD 125,000 to USD 250,000

events.label: Lockdown
events.note: The Prime Minister announced a lockdown of the whole country for 21 days from midnight on 24 March 2020.
events.quote: a complete lockdown of the entire nation for the next 21 days

events.label: Tax at source, 5%
events.note: From 1 October 2020, banks collect tax at source of 5% on LRS remittances above ₹7 lakh in a financial year (Finance Act 2020, section 206C(1G)).
events.quote: at the rate of five per cent of the amount

events.label: Tax at source, 20%
events.note: The higher rates of the Finance Act 2023 (20% above ₹7 lakh, except for education and medical treatment) applied from 1 October 2023, moved from 1 July 2023.
events.quote: Increased TCS rates to apply from 1st October, 2023

events.label: Tax threshold ₹10 lakh
events.note: The Budget for 2025-26 raised the threshold for TCS on LRS remittances from ₹7 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
events.quote: proposed to be increased from ₹ 7 lakh to ₹ 10 lakh
